title: Avro Lancaster LM616
memorial_details: Aircraft crashed into West End Farm, Great Offley killing all members of the crew and three members of the Handley family in the farm house. Grey tablet flat on ground, a few feet South East of the Parish War Memorial.
inscription: [115 Squadron badge] This plaque is in / memory of the crew / and civilians / killed when the / Lancaster Bomber / III KM616 KO-J / crashed into / West End Farm / Great Offley / on 18th July 1944 / Their names will live for ever more
community_connection: Inscription explicitly states both crew and civilians were killed in the crash
